question: If 10% of 60% of 2/3 of a number is 841, then find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentages to fractions: 10% = 1/10 and 60% = 3/5.

Net combined multiplier = (1/10) × (3/5) × (2/3) = 6/150 = 1/25.

Given: (1/25) × Number = 841.

Number = 841 × 25 = 21025.

**∴ The correct answer is 21025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

10% of 60% of 2/3 of a number = 841

**Formula Used:**

Value = Base × (Percentage/100) | Fraction of Value = Value × (a/b)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc06a287d42719dcc8ea6ee447dfa255b76f386e0ecd31c48341a17a90300260.png] 

Let the number be x.

⇒ (10/100) × (60/100) × (2/3) × x = 841

⇒ (1/10) × (3/5) × (2/3) × x = 841

⇒ (1 × 3 × 2) / (10 × 5 × 3) × x = 841

⇒ (6 / 150) × x = 841

⇒ (1 / 25) × x = 841

⇒ x = 841 × 25

⇒ x = 21025

**∴ The correct answer is 21025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide by 100 and simplify. Example: 10% = 10/100 = 1/10.

Successive Multipliers

When taking percentages of percentages, simply multiply the respective fractions or decimals together to find the net effect.

Fractional Multiplication

"Of" in mathematical word problems generally translates to multiplication (×). Example: a/b of c = (a/b) × c.
